chapter.verse: Tua ni mahin tua inn pan Jesu paikhia-in tuili gei-ah tu hi.
Ama' kiim ah mihonpi kikaikhawm ahih manin gunkuang sungah lutin tusuk hi. Mihonpi ahihleh tuinawl piau tungah ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin thugentehte zangin amaute thu tampi hilh hi: “En un! Khaici vawhpa khat khaici vawh dingin kuankhia hi.
Khaici a vawh ciangin kimkhat lam dungah tu a, vasate hong pai-in netum uh hi.
Kimkhat lei a tawmna suangpi taw-phah leitang tungah tu a, lei sah lo ahih manin kungno poto pah hi.
Ahih hangin ni a suah ciangin nisa in hul gawp a, zungthuk kha lo uh ahih manin vulin keu uh hi.
Kimkhat lingbu lakah tu a, lingte hong khangin kungnote depcip hi.
Kimkhat lei hoih tungah tu a, gahleteh nei-in kimkhat a zah zakhat, kimkhat sawmguk, kimkhat sawmthum, cih bangin piang hi.
Bil neite in za ta hen.”
Tua ciangin nungzuite hong pai uh a, Jesu' kiangah, “Bang hangin mihonpi' tungah thugentehte tawh gen na hi hiam?” ci-in dong uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Vantung kumpigam thuthukte theih nading thu note hong kipia a, ahi zongin amaute kipia nailo hi.
A hang pen a neite kipiabeh ding a, a dimletin nei ding uh hi. A neilote ahihleh a neihsun nangawn kilaksak ding hi.
Mihonpi' tungah thugentehte tawh ka genna a hang hih bang hi: Amaute in mu napi mu lo uh a, za napi za lo-in, zong tel lo uh hi.
A taktakin amau tawh kisai Isaiah' kamsanna a tangtung ahi hi: ‘Ngai-in na zak uh hangin na tel ngeikei ding uh a, enin na muh uh hangin thu na phawk ngeikei ding uh hi.

A hang pen hih mite lungmawl ta uh a, a bil uh tawh a za mialmial ciang bek hi-in a mitte uh si khinzo uh hi; Tua hikeileh a mit uh tawh mukha-in a bil uh tawh zakha ding uh a, a lungsim uh tawh telkha-in hong kiheikha ding uh a, amaute ka damsak hong kul ding ahi hi.’
“Ahi zongin na mitte un mu ahih manin, leh na bilte un za ahih manin, amaute thuphangah ahi uh hi.
A hang pen maantak kong cihin ah kamsangte leh midikte tampi mah in na muhte uh mu nuam napi mukha lo uh a, na zakte uh za nuam napi zakha lo uh hi.
“Tua ahih ciangin khaici vawhpa thugenteh na ngai un:
Mi khatpeuh in kumpigam thu za napi-in a tel loh ciangin Gilopa hong pai-in a lungtang sunga kivawhsa pen hepkhiatsak hi. Tua pen lam dunga kivawh pen ahi hi.
Suangpi taw-phah leitang tunga kivawh cih pen Pasian' thu a zak ciangin nuamna tawh a sang pah mi cihna hi.
Ahi zongin ama' sungah zung kha lo ahih manin tawmvei sung kimang sam napi Pasian' thu hangin gimna ahihkeileh bawlsiatna a tun ciangin puk pah hi.
Lingbu laka kivawh cih ciangin Pasian' thu za napi leitung lunghihmawhna leh mihaute eenna cihte in Pasian' thu gakcip ahih manin gahleteh nei lo cihna hi.
Lei hoih tunga kivawh cih ciangin Pasian' thu za-in tel cihna hi a, amah in gahleteh nei-in hun khat ciangin a zah zakhat, a kik ciangin a zah sawmguk, a kik khat ciangin a zah sawmthum piang hi.”
Jesu in mihonpi' tungah thugenteh dang khat gen hi: “Vantung kumpigam pen a lo ah khaici hoih a vawh mipa tawh kibang hi.
Ama' mite a ihmut laitakun a galpa hong pai-in taang lakah tahum tang vawhin paikhia hi.
Kungnote hong poto-in a vuih ciangin tahum kungte zong hong om hi.
Inntekpa' silate hong pai-in ama' kiangah, ‘Pu aw, na lo ah khaici hoih vawh hilo na hi hiam? Tua kimlai tahumte hong bangci om ahi hiam?’ ci uh hi.
Amah in, ‘Tua pen galte khat' bawl hi,’ ci hi. Tua ciangin silate in, ‘Tua ahihleh pai-in ka va bot ding uh hiam?’ ci uh hi.
Ahi zongin amah in, ‘Va bot kei un. Tahumte na bot uhleh taangte zong na botkhawmkha ding uh hi.
Anlak hun mateng a nam nihin po phot hen. Anlak hun a tun ciangin anlate' kiangah, "Tahumte bot masa unla haltum dingin lomhen un. Taangte ahihleh ka ansal ah khol un," ka ci ding hi,’ ci hi.”
Jesu in mihonpi' tungah thugenteh dang khat gen leuleu a, “Vantung kumpigam pen ankamtang, mi khat in phamin a lo-a a vawh pen, tawh kibang hi.
Khaici tang khempeuh lakah ankamtang a neupen ahih hangin a khan ciangin ankung khempeuh sangin golzaw a, singkung khat suakin van-a leng vasate hong pai-in a hiangte tungah bu tom uh hi,” ci hi.
Thugenteh a dang khat gen leuleu a, “Vantung kumpigam pen nupi khat in annel lawhbeu thum sunga a sawh, annel a bupin a pawmkim dongin a koih, silngo tawh kibang hi,” ci hi.
Jesu in mihonpi' tungah hih thute khempeuh thugenteh zangin gen a, a taktakin amaute' tungah thugenteh lo tawh a gen bangmah om lo hi.
Tua pen a nuai-a kamsangpa' thugen a tangtun nading ahi hi: “Thugentehte tawh ka kam ka hong ding a, leitung kilamkip huna kipan a kiseelcip thu ka genkhia ding hi.”
Tua ciangin Jesu in mihonpi nusia-in inn sungah lut hi. Ama' nungzuite hong pai uh a, “Lo sunga tahum thugenteh kote hong gentel in,” ci uh hi.
Jesu in hih bangin dawng hi: “Khaici hoih a vawh pen Mihing' Tapa ahi hi.
Lo pen leitung hi a, khaici hoih cih pen kumpigam' tate ahi hi. Tahum pen Gilopa' tate hi a,
tuate a vawh galpa pen dawimangpa ahi hi. Anlak hun cih ciangin khanghun bei hun hi a, anlate pen vanmite ahi uh hi.
Tahumte kilomhenin meikhuk ah a kihaltum mah bangin khanghun bei ciangin zong tua bang mah hiding hi.
Mihing' Tapa in a vanmite sawl ding a, amaute in kumpigam pan palkhaktheih thu khempeuh leh thukhun pampaihna a sem khempeuh botkhia-in
meikhukpi sungah lawnkhia ding uh hi. Tua mun ah kahna leh hagawina om ding hi.
Tua hun ciangin midikte ahihleh a Pa uh' kumpigam sungah ni bangin taang ding uh hi. Bil neite in za ta hen.
“Vantung kumpigam pen lo sunga kiseel, mi khat in tuakkha-in a selkik, vanmanpha tawh kibang hi. Nuamna tawh amah paikhia-in a neihsa khempeuh zuakin tua lo lei hi.
“Tua banah vantung kumpigam pen kep hoih a zong sumbawlpa tawh zong kibang hi.
Amah in kep a manpha mahmah khat a muh ciangin paikhia-in a neihsa khempeuh zuakin tua kep lei hi.
“Tua banah vantung kumpigam pen tuili sunga kikhuh, ngasa namkim a awkna ngen tawh zong kibang hi.
Ngen a dim ciangin mite in tuinawl piauzang ah ngen kai-in tusuk uh a, a limci teng bawm sungah guangin nek theihloh teng paai uh hi.
Khanghun a bei ciangin zong tua bang mah hiding hi. Vanmite hong pai-in midikte lakpan migilote khenkhia ding uh a,
meikhukpi sungah tua mite lawnkhia ding uh hi. Tua mun ah kahna leh hagawina om ding hi.”
“Hih ka thugente a vekin na tel uh hiam?” Nungzuite in, “Ka tel uh hi,” ci uh hi.
Tua ciangin Jesu in, “Tua ahih manin vantung kumpigam' ading sinna a nei laisiamte khempeuh pen ama' vanmanpha kholna bung sungpan a thak leh a lui a lakhia inntekpa tawh kibang hi,” ci hi.
Hih thugentehte a gen khit ciangin Jesu tua lai pan paikhia hi.
A pianna khua tungin vengkhawm inn ah thu a hilh ciangin mite in lamdang sa mahmah uh a, “Hih mipa in hih bang pilna leh hih nalamdangte koi pan ngah ahi hiam?
Amah innlampa' tapa hilo hiam? A nu Mary a kicinu hilo hiam? A sanggam pasalte zong James, Joseph, Simon leh Judas hilo hiam?
A sanggam numeite zong a vekun hih takah ei tawh om uh hilo hiam? Tua kimlai hih mipa in hihte khempeuh koi pan ngah ahi hiam?” ci uh hi.
Tua hi a, Jesu' tungah mite hehin lungkia uh hi. Ahih hangin Jesu in amaute' kiangah, “Kamsang khat pen ama' pianna khua leh ama' innkuan sungah cihloh koikoi ah kithupibawl lo-in om lo hi,” ci hi.
Tua hi a, Jesu in amaute' uplohna huhau-in tua takah nalamdang tampitak bawl lo hi.
